description: This file defines the StreamSubscriptionHandlerFactory class, which implements a factory for creating StreamSubscriptionHandle instances based on stream provider and subscription details within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class to instantiate stream subscription handles for specific stream identifiers and provider details.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new StreamSubscriptionHandle for a specified type T, using the stored stream provider and subscription details.
